plan.title: Overdeck Anywhere: "Continue on another device" from the conversation itself
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Nothing on the conversation the operator is looking at says 'take this with you'. Opening it on a paired phone needs a reachable link (Copy link uses the loopback origin) and pairing lives only in Settings; handing it to another Overdeck machine means waiting out the 30 s settle debounce and the other machine's 5-minute sync, with nothing on this machine saying the conversation will split if it keeps going.
narratives.Proposal: One menu entry, 'Continue on another device', in the conversation header and row menus opens a dialog (global zustand host) with two tabs. 'Open on another screen' shows a QR code and Copy link for <trusted non-loopback address>/conv/<id>, optionally with a one-time #pair credential for root sessions (credential kind exposed as viewer.kind on GET /api/anywhere/status). 'Hand off to another machine' calls a new POST /api/vault/sessions/by-conversation/:name/settle that settles the transcript now through the vault-service queue (shared settleOnQueue, WIP force), reports the version or the blocked reason with its fix command, and leaves a per-browser composer notice. Vault browse rows get 'Check for new conversations' (PAN-4446 Sync now). PRD: .pan/drafts/PAN-4455.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Live mirroring or push notifications to the other machine (PAN-4402, PAN-4405, PAN-2354)
- A tunnel or relay to reach this machine from outside the LAN or tailnet (PAN-2352, PAN-2356)
- A mobile-specific conversation layout (PAN-2355)
- Any change to settle, adoption or fork semantics, or to the vault list-cache shape
- Stopping the session automatically on hand-off
- A server-side record of hand-offs; the composer notice is per browser
- Any new server route besides POST /api/vault/sessions/by-conversation/:name/settle
- Changes to PairDeviceDialog.tsx or Settings → Anywhere
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap

autoDecisions.rationale: pan vault save and the poller's leave-list path use force; a hand-off is exactly when uncommitted code should travel (D-7).

autoDecisions.summary: A noop settle is reported as a successful hand-off with the latest version.
autoDecisions.rationale: The poller usually settled the conversation already; reporting the existing version is truthful and avoids a confusing failure (D-8).

autoDecisions.summary: The browser learns its credential kind from a new viewer.kind field on GET /api/anywhere/status.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue forbids a new route for the screen tab and the frontend has no other way to know root vs device before requesting a credential (D-3).

autoDecisions.summary: The plain link always shows; 'Also pair the device' mints a credential only when 'Create pairing link' is clicked.
autoDecisions.rationale: Opening the dialog must not burn a one-use credential; the issue says the fragment is appended when the link is created (D-4).

autoDecisions.summary: Default tab: hand-off only when there is no reachable address and the vault is ready and the harness is supported; otherwise the screen tab.
autoDecisions.rationale: Deterministic rule matching 'chosen by default from what this machine can do'; the screen tab works on any machine with an address (D-2).

autoDecisions.summary: A code-snapshot problem after a saved transcript is shown as not-a-success and records no composer notice.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue lists a snapshot over wipMaxBytes among blocked saves that must not claim success (D-10).

autoDecisions.summary: The composer notice is per-browser state in localStorage, shown only while the session is alive and superseded by PAN-4447's continuity notice.
autoDecisions.rationale: A hand-off is an operator act, not derivable state; stacking two notices would contradict each other (D-15, D-16).

autoDecisions.summary: 'Check for new conversations' is a menu item on vault browse rows, visible only when the vault service runs.
autoDecisions.rationale: Sync now returns 409 on a dashboard without the sync loop (PAN-4446 D-6); querying status only while the menu is open avoids per-row polling (D-17).

autoDecisions.summary: No line-count field is added to the vault list cache; the integration test reads the line count from the synced record.
autoDecisions.rationale: Changing list-cache shape is outside the issue's scope (D-19).

autoDecisions.summary: ConversationPanel.tsx stays at or under its 1531-line cap by extracting the About drawer.
autoDecisions.rationale: The file sits exactly at its allowlist cap and agents may not raise caps (D-20).

autoDecisions.summary: Hand-off messages are built in the dashboard service instead of importing src/cli/commands/vault/save.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: The dashboard server never imports src/cli; the strings are few and fixed in the PRD (D-12).

autoDecisions.summary: Plan carries a sizeJustification instead of splitting into sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: Every acceptance criterion hangs off one menu entry and one dialog; a sibling split would leave PAN-4455's own AC list unmet.

metadata.sizeJustification: The issue's acceptance criteria all hang off one menu entry and one two-tab dialog: the server route, the credential-kind field, both tabs, the composer notice and the receiving-side action are each required by a numbered AC of PAN-4455, so a sibling split would leave this issue's own AC list unmet. The surface is wide (server route + service, Anywhere status, frontend dialog, two menus, composer, four doc pages) but every item is a small vertical slice with its own tests, and the DAG lets the frontend and backend halves run in parallel.
